svg.title: Policies, Their Controls, and Their Subjects

g.text: Policies, Their Controls, and Their Subjects
Each policy, the controls that implement it, and the systems and data it applies to directly. A policy with subjects but no controls is only a statement of intent; a policy with controls but no
subjects is enforced somewhere the model has not recorded.
Cardholder data scope and evidence maintenance
